description: This file defines an Android activity named SecureSurfaceViewActivity that demonstrates creating a secure GLSurfaceView with a renderer. It showcases how to set up and enforce secure rendering surfaces where content cannot be captured or mirrored onto non-secure displays. The activity manages the lifecycle of the GLSurfaceView, including setting it up in onCreate, resuming in onResume, and pausing in onPause.

classes.name: SecureSurfaceViewActivity
classes.description: An activity demonstrating how to create and display a secure GLSurfaceView with a custom renderer, emphasizing content security features and lifecycle management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and configures the GLSurfaceView for secure rendering.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes rendering of the GLSurfaceView when the activity becomes visible.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses rendering of the GLSurfaceView when the activity is no longer in the foreground.
